name: garden-skills
description: ConardLi's open-source Skills collection, featuring web design, knowledge retrieval, image generation, and more.
one_liner: A free grab-bag of ready-made AI agent recipes for making polished websites, images, and short promo videos faster.
buyer: A freelance web designer or solo indie hacker who wants to turn client briefs or product ideas into polished output faster, without hiring a designer or video editor.
business_use_cases: A freelance designer uses the 'web-design-engineer' skill to turn client briefs into polished sites faster, taking on more clients at the same rate.
A solo SaaS founder uses the 'motion-showreel' and 'web-video-presentation' skills to produce marketing videos without hiring a video editor.
A small agency curates and sells niche skill bundles (e.g. for restaurant or real-estate sites) built on top of this collection.

money_ideas.idea: Paid custom skill-bundle commissions for a specific industry niche.
Faster freelance throughput lets a designer take more clients at the same hourly rate.

steal_this: Wrap the 'web-design-engineer' and 'beautiful-article' skills into a $49 one-click 'make my landing page pretty' service for indie hackers this weekend.
